signature: SUBROUTINE DTRSYL( TRANA, TRANB, ISGN, M, N, A, LDA, B, LDB, C,

params.name: trana
params.reference:
Specifies the option op(A):

-   `= 'N'`: $\operatorname{op}(A) = A$    (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $\operatorname{op}(A) = A^T$ (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $\operatorname{op}(A) = A^H$ (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: tranb
params.reference:
Specifies the option op(B):

-   `= 'N'`: $\operatorname{op}(B) = B$    (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $\operatorname{op}(B) = B^T$ (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $\operatorname{op}(B) = B^H$ (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: isgn
params.reference:
Specifies the sign in the equation: = +1: solve $\operatorname{op}(A) \, X + X \, \operatorname{op}(B)$ = scale\*C

-   `= -1`: solve $\operatorname{op}(A) \, X - X \, \operatorname{op}(B)$ = scale\*C

params.name: M
params.reference: The order of the matrix A, and the number of rows in the matrices X and C. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix B, and the number of columns in the matrices X and C. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The upper quasi-triangular matrix A, in Schur canonical form.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: The upper quasi-triangular matrix B, in Schur canonical form.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N right hand side matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$

params.name: scale
params.reference: The scale factor, scale, set \<= 1 to avoid overflow in X.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `= 1`: A and B have common or very close eigenvalues; perturbed values were used to solve the equation (but the matrices A and B are unchanged).
